item.title: MirrorCam 1.4.1
item.description: - The mirror is always 16:9, the shape video calls use, with every camera (newer MacBook cameras made it square) - Pick your camera from the new camera button at the top of the controls, or in Settings (your iPhone shows up when it's nearby) - The line in the bottom corner starts with the camera in use and shows and fades with the controls - The controls stay exactly in place when you turn the light on or off, and resizing is smooth with no snap when you let go - Fixes: About opens in front when MirrorCam floats on top, ⌘ shortcuts no longer trigger the panel's keys, and the camera starts on its own once you allow it in System Settings
